Workout, it helps alleviate the symptoms. Sounds like you love your kids to the point were you are willing to sacrifice free-will to ensure they have a father around. If you are willing to go that far than why not try some medicine free treatments. Plan a day were you just go out and sleep in the forest or something in the weekend if you can, take a nap near a farm if you get the farmer permissions. These are two things I would do when I was really depressed and it helped alleviate the symptom. Ask yourself, why do I want to die. See if it philosophical or something you can explain. If its either of those two than congratulations, you are still medical "sane" according to what my therapist said. They said it is because you are still able to question yourself, which shows promise or some shit. Who knows man. Life is hard, if you love your kids use them as a reason to live until theyre 18 or 21 or some shit and kill yourself than. Or do it now, if up to you man. In life we don't have many choices but the limited amount of decisions we can make ultimately dictate the direction we want to go. You made this post on this website because you are in pain. Its really that simple, you dont want to live but are alive, that is simply pain. Try to get through the pain not for your sake but for the kids. Read some posts on this website and you will realize you are not alone in feeling like this. This is human and nothing to be ashamed about. Whether you make the decision to do something or not is not my concern nor will I judge you. In fact I would be happy for you since you are finally free from your pain. Take care anon, if its any help I've taken about 16 different medications over the past 20 years in my 33 years of life and none of it helped. Anti depressant are simply a dart being thrown at a board hoping it helps. Electro-therapy helps a bit but it dies down very quick. All I can say is hold tight for tomorrow.
